WITH filtered_jobs AS (
    SELECT jpf.job_id, jpf.salary_year_avg
    FROM job_postings_fact jpf
    WHERE jpf.job_title_short LIKE '%Data Analyst%'
      AND jpf.salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND jpf.job_work_from_home = 1
),
skill_counts AS (
    SELECT sjd.job_id, sjd.skill_id, COUNT(*) as skill_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sjd.job_id ORDER BY skill_count DESC) as rn
    FROM job_postings_fact jpf
    JOIN skills_job_dim sjd ON jpf.job_id = sjd.job_id
    WHERE jpf.job_title_short LIKE '%Data Analyst%'
      AND jpf.salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND jpf.job_work_from_home = 1
    GROUP BY sjd.job_id, sjd.skill_id
),
top_skills_per_job AS (
    SELECT job_id, skill_id
    FROM skill_counts
    WHERE rn = 1
),
top_skills AS (
    SELECT skill_id
    FROM top_skills_per_job
),
filtered_jobs_with_skills AS (
    SELECT fj.job_id, fj.salary_year_avg
    FROM filtered_jobs fj
    JOIN skills_job_dim sjd ON fj.job_id = sjd.job_id
    WHERE sjd.skill_id IN (SELECT skill_id FROM top_skills)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT job_id) as job_count, AVG(salary_year_avg) as average_salary
FROM filtered_jobs_with_skills

WITH data_analyst_jobs AS (
    SELECT 
        job_id
    FROM job_postings_fact
    WHERE job_title_short = 'Data Analyst'
      AND salary_year_avg IS NOT NULL
      AND job_work_from_home = 1
),
skill_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        sj.skill_id,
        COUNT(*) as skill_count
    FROM data_analyst_jobs da
    JOIN skills_job_dim sj ON da.job_id = sj.job_id
    JOIN skills_dim s ON sj.skill_id = s.skill_id
    WHERE sj.skill_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY sj.skill_id
),
top_3_skills AS (
    SELECT 
        skill_id
    FROM skill_counts
    ORDER BY skill_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
jobs_with_top_skills AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        da.job_id
    FROM data_analyst_jobs da
    JOIN skills_job_dim sj ON da.job_id = sj.job_id
    JOIN top_3_skills t ON sj.skill_id = t.skill_id
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as num_jobs,
    SUM(salary_year_avg) as total_salary,
    AVG(salary_year_avg) as avg_salary
FROM jobs_with_top_skills jws
JOIN job_postings_fact jp ON jws.job_id = jp.job_id
